prompt_text: Who is the best moving company in Pleasanton CA for a local move?
answer_verbatim:
**All Star Movers & Storage** is a strong first company to get a quote from for a local Pleasanton move. moveBuddha ranks it highest among Pleasanton-area movers in its local-mover roundup, at **4.52/5**. [moveBuddha’s Pleasanton rankings](https://www.movebuddha.com/movers/ca/pleasanton/)

I’d still compare at least two written estimates—rankings and review scores vary by site. **Ontrack Moving** and **Magic Moving & Storage** are also worth checking. Before booking, verify the mover’s California household-goods carrier license, ask for a written estimate, and confirm what the quoted price includes.
